tool_config.name: create_callback_request
tool_config.description: Record a Callback Request: the Foreman asked for someone at the office to call him back and said yes to recording it. Call it once, only after that yes. Returns {"ref": "R-1042"}. Returns {"error": "..."} if it could not be saved. It returns no callback time: there is none to give.

request_body_schema.description: What the callback is about, if the Foreman said.

reason.description: The Foreman's answer to "What's it about?", in his own words. Leave it out when he gave no answer or did not want to say.
